actions.reason: K5_C0002 has an interpretable metabolic/mitochondrial transcriptomic phenotype (oxidative phosphorylation, fatty acid metabolism, adipogenesis, mTORC1; FDR q=0.001), but membership representation is coherently absent: CT near-zero (0.022) and RNA (-0.082), WSI (-0.064), WXS (-0.083) all negative with within-label distances exceeding distances to the nearest competing set, and the nearest competitor differs across views (K5_C0004, K5_C0003, K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005). Candidate-specific confounders survive correction (tissue source site V=0.418, CT manufacturer V=0.320, reconstruction kernel V=0.346, scanner model V=0.338, slice thickness epsilon²=0.170, z spacing epsilon²=0.181), remaining plausible alternative explanations for the membership. Its boundaries are weak and merge-compatible: the K5_C0002–K5_C0003 boundary shows only weak, partially conflicting separation (CT 0.146 vs RNA/WSI/WXS 0.031–0.080), and the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0002 boundary is weak across all four views (silhouettes 0.040–0.170). No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining evidence could change the conclusion.

K5_C0003 has an interpretable immune/inflammatory transcriptomic phenotype (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6/JAK/STAT3; FDR q=0.001), but membership representation is conflicting: RNA (0.144) and CT (0.042) provide modest support while WSI (-0.070) and WXS (-0.086) are negative with within-label distances exceeding distances to the nearest competing set, and the nearest competitor differs across views (K5_C0004, K5_C0002, K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005). Candidate-specific confounders survive correction (tissue source site V=0.414, slice thickness epsilon²=0.0517, z spacing epsilon²=0.0767), remaining plausible alternative explanations. Its boundaries are weak and merge-compatible: K5_C0002–K5_C0003 shows only weak, partially conflicting separation (CT 0.146 vs RNA/WSI/WXS 0.031–0.080), and K5_C0003–K5_C0004 is mixed (WXS 0.432/RNA 0.112 vs CT 0.056/WSI 0.039). No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining evidence could change the conclusion.

K5_C0004 has an interpretable EMT/angiogenesis transcriptomic phenotype (EMT NES 2.34, UV-response-DN 2.19, Hedgehog, angiogenesis; FDR q=0.001), but membership representation is conflicting and dominated by no representation: CT (-0.052), RNA (-0.053), and WSI (-0.066) all negative with within-label distances exceeding distances to the nearest competing set (predominantly K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005), while the WXS silhouette of 1.0 with zero within-label distance is a degenerate geometry that cannot serve as credible independent support. Its boundary with K5_C0003 is mixed (WXS 0.432/RNA 0.112 vs CT 0.056/WSI 0.039), and the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0004 boundary is weak (mean between-affinity 0.108). No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining evidence could change the conclusion.

K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005 has an interpretable mutation phenotype (PBRM1 OR 15.66, q_driver=4.95e-08; VHL enrichment, BAP1 depletion), but membership representation is weak and mixed: CT shows no distinction (-0.070, 97.4% negative) and is closer to K5_C0004 than to its own label, RNA is near-zero (0.021), and only WSI (0.064) and WXS (0.092) provide small positive separation. All four views agree K5_C0004 is the nearest competing set, so the boundary context is not uniform. Its boundary with K5_C0002 is weak across all four views (silhouettes 0.040–0.170), and the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0003 and –K5_C0004 boundaries are the weakest in the partition (mean between-affinity 0.111 and 0.108). No supported split or merge alternative rescues it, and no remaining evidence could change the conclusion.
